title: Green's Theorem
subtitle: Vector Calculus · 2D curl
summary: Relates a line integral around a closed curve to a double integral over the enclosed region.
detail:
\[ \oint_C(P\,dx+Q\,dy) = \iint_D\!\left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)dA \]

Special case of Stokes' theorem in 2D. The quantity \(\partial Q/\partial x - \partial P/\partial y\) is the z-component of the curl \(\nabla\times F\). Used to compute areas and evaluate line integrals.
